column1: # The remaining unit menus, read off a vanilla Art of Conquest game, one row per
# epoch, positions left to right. `-` is an empty position. Format and reasoning
# Names here are AS SEEN ON SCREEN and still need reconciling to the display
# names in Objects.py before this becomes UnitSlots.py — the game's UI and the
# object database disagree often ("Ballista" against `Gun Spear06 Balistae`,
# against `Domestic Wolf`). Recorded verbatim rather than translated on the way
# in, because a wrong translation here is invisible later.
# Watch for one collision when reconciling: the Siege Factory's tier-4 unit
# shows as "Siege Tower" and the database calls it `Siege04 - Tower`, which
# displays as "Tower" — the same display name as the Tower building added for
